newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Southcorp says on track for forecasts.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Southcorp says on track for forecasts.

text.p: Wine, packaging and appliance manufacturer Southcorp Holdings Ltd said on Thursday it was on track to meet market forecasts of a 10 to 15 percent rise in net profit before abnormals for 1996/97 (July-June).
"The markets Southcorp to be up 10 to 15 percent and we are on track for that sort of range," Southcorp managing director Graham Kraehe told reporters.

Kraehe said he did not want to reveal details of Southcorp's performance ahead of interim results due in a month, "but we finished the year (1996) pretty much as expected and we are reasonably confident about the outlook".

Kraehe said recent strength in its shares, which on Thursday struck a new year high at A$4.38, reflected demonstrated earnings growth across all sections of the business and an understanding by the market of Southcorp's growth potential, in contrast to the general flat outlook for industrial stocks.
Southcorp reported a net profit of A$124.2 million in 1995/96 and an abnormal loss of A$630,000.
